description: This file defines a ForbiddenException class used for handling HTTP 403 Forbidden errors within the OrangeHRM project's authentication exception namespace. The class implements the HttpExceptionInterface and extends the base Exception class, providing methods to get and set HTTP status codes and headers related to forbidden responses.

classes.name: ForbiddenException
classes.description: A custom exception class for HTTP 403 Forbidden errors, implementing HttpExceptionInterface and managing status code and headers information.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the ForbiddenException, defaulting to 403.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code for the exception.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the headers associated with the exception response.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the exception response.
